description: This file defines a PHP class 'TrackerListController' within the 'OrangeHRM\Performance\Controller' namespace. It extends an abstract controller and sets up a Vue component called 'performance-tracker-list' during the pre-render phase, likely for rendering a performance tracker list in the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: TrackerListController
classes.description: Extends AbstractVueController to set up a Vue component for displaying a performance tracker list.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the component for rendering by creating an instance of 'performance-tracker-list' and assigning it to the controller.
